<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, which matches the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No ~1:1 M+2 pattern for bromine is present, and the M+2 intensity is far higher than expected for sulfur alone. Therefore, chlorine can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
